'''Kata the Hutt''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He ran illegal pit fights on the Smugglers' Moon in the [[Nikto Sector]], the profits from which he used to fund separatists movements on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and other war-torn planets. Agent [[Jatta Kuum]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] asked an ally of the Republic to destroy the Hutt's vault. By doing so, the individual stopped the pit fights and cut off the funding of the separatist movements.<ref name="Blood Money" />
